summary: AXIA Energia S.A. filed a 6-K reporting a Board-approved partial mandatory redemption of 37,237,014 Class C preferred shares (6.14% outstanding, R$2 billion) and corresponding ADSs. Redemption price is R$53.71 per share, based on prevailing common share price, payable in cash on/after August 24, 2026 effective date. Holders may elect conversion to common shares at 1.1:1 instead, but ADS holders cannot. Redemption applies pro rata, fractions disregarded, ADS payment via Citibank depositary. What to watch: cash-funded return of capital, conversion election dynamics, and post-redemption share count reduction.
